home.about: A beautifully updated mid-century modern home in Lake Highlands' Lakeland Hills, with walls of windows, hardwood floors and a painted-brick accent wall. The island kitchen opens to the living area, and the turfed backyard adds a putting green and a back house with its own full bath.

Cash to close includes seller title credits of $3,497 (5% down) and $3,546 (20% down), which must be agreed in the contract and are subject to loan program limits. neighborhood.community: Lakeland Hills is one of Dallas' best-known mid-century modern neighborhoods, a Lake Highlands pocket of low-slung ranch homes and mature trees. White Rock Creek's trails and Flag Pole Hill Park are a short drive away, and Lakeridge Village adds a brewery, a bistro and Michelin-recognized tacos. Richardson ISD schools serve the home.
